description: mmse_resampler_ff at resampling ratio 2.5, initial mu 0.6

fixed_vs_float.rationale: The ratio is an f32 value (exact on the 2^-32 position grid), so positions and table rows equal the float instance. Taps rounded to the format: sum of |tap rounding error| <= 8 * 0.5 LSB acting on a peak of 0.76 FS, plus 0.5 LSB output rounding: <= 3.5 LSB per component.

The ratio is an f32 value (exact on the 2^-32 position grid), so positions and table rows equal the float instance. Taps rounded to the format: sum of |tap rounding error| <= 8 * 0.5 LSB acting on a peak of 0.76 FS, plus 0.5 LSB output rounding: <= 3.5 LSB per component.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Positions are computed in double exactly like GNU Radio (same additions and floor), so both pick the same window and table row; the outputs differ only by f32 rounding of the 8-tap sum (GNU Radio uses a SIMD dot product): per component below 8 * 2^-24 * peak * sum|taps| (sum|taps| <= 1.06, peak 0.76) = 4e-7 for each order, the bound allows 2e-6.

name: mmse_resampler_ff_2p5
